description: This source file defines classes and functions related to tokenization of expressions within the vtiger CRM's workflow module. It includes token classes, a tokenizer class, and a space filter class used for parsing expression strings into tokens.

classes.name: VTExpressionToken
classes.description: Represents a token with a label and optional value, used during tokenization.

classes.name: VTExpressionTokenizer
classes.description: Tokenizes an expression string into tokens based on predefined patterns.

classes.name: VTExpressionSpaceFilter
classes.description: Filters out whitespace tokens from a token stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for VTExpressionToken; initializes token with label.

methods.name: _vt_processtoken_id
methods.description: Processes a token as an ID token, returning it unmodified.

methods.name: _vt_processtoken_symbol
methods.description: Processes a token as a symbol, wrapping it in VTExpressionSymbol object.

methods.name: nextToken
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the expression, advancing the token stream.
